summary: All 25 defects were reconciled by static reading of the 27273fb archive: 15 confirmed, 9 resolved, 1 device_required, 0 disputed. No tests or builds were run, and nothing was edited. Phase 01 stays blocked: LATE-EMBED, PICKER-MEMORY, GALLERY-MEMORY and SUGGESTION-ENTRY are the P1 software blockers. Severity changes from input: P01-SHEET goes from P0 to P2 because integration is real and only the fixed-map, handle and first-measure gaps remain. P01-DOC-TRUTH goes from P1 to P2 because contradictions are limited to the progress ledger, whose authoritative sections and the other three docs say BLOCKED. All other severities match the input.

assessments.evidence: Integration is real: ActivitySheet wraps the screen content at ActivityDetail.jsx:192, and pointer and arrow-key detents run through lib/activitySheet.js. Safe-area padding and the fixed page are in styles.css:1162-1165. The P0 'helper not integrated' claim is resolved, but three gaps remain. (1) The map is not fixed: on phones .detail-map-layer is flex:1 1 auto (styles.css:1163) beside the height-driven sheet, so every drag frame and each frame of the .28s height transition (styles.css:1140) changes the surface height. ResizeObserver then calls mount(), which sends appleMaps.resize (AppleMap.jsx:158-163,206). (2) The handle, the only drag target, has min-height:30px (styles.css:1141), below 44pt. (3) useState(viewportHeight) runs in the first render before .detail-sheet-page is committed, so querySelector returns null and the first measurement uses raw innerHeight without the top safe-area subtraction (ActivitySheet.jsx:9-24,32). It is only re-measured on a resize event, so rendered height and aria-valuenow can exceed the CSS max-height clamp at styles.css:1165. Existing ActivitySheet tests are real component tests, but 'exactly one resize' describes an instant jsdom change, not a drag.
assessments.regression_test: Existing: ActivitySheet.test.jsx 'tracks a pointer without a height transition and restores detent snapping on release'; ActivityDetail.test.jsx 'keeps one map and never re-embeds it when the details sheet moves'. Needed: a screen-level test that a multi-frame drag leaves the native frame unchanged or coalesces resize to settle; a test that the first render uses the safe-area-adjusted height; a 44pt handle assertion.

assessments.evidence: Actual order at ActivityDetail.jsx:194-196 is heading, ActivitySummary, ActivityMoments, ahead of every technical section. With photos, ActivityMoments shows a primary Add photos and Find journey photos in the head (ActivityMoments.jsx:22-25) and the cover at :27-30. Without photos, the empty state offers one-tap Add at :31-38. recordedJourney derives cover only from a real local photo (recorder.js:99), so the dead hero tap the old review mentioned is not reachable for local trips. The separately tracked P01-SUGGESTION-ENTRY defect stays open.
assessments.regression_test: Existing: ActivityDetail.test.jsx 'shows moments above the technical settings so photos are not buried'; src/components/ActivityMoments.test.jsx.

assessments.evidence: attachPhoto computes identity from sourceAssetID or asset.localIdentifier and returns false through containsPhotoAsset before the capacity guard and before writing bytes (ActivityServices.swift:185-187, write at :205). This works at capacity and after a lost reply. Identity is matched by assetID only, never by timestamp (RecorderCore.swift:2276-2279). It persists as optional ActivityPhoto.assetID (RecorderCore.swift:636) in owner-specific storage. Both entry points run on the main queue with owner guards (PhotoSuggestions.swift:77-80; ActivityServices.swift:533-546). The JS side receives assetID through the ...p spread (recorder.js:98), so 'Already added' works. Two non-blocking notes: images are still decoded before the check, which is tracked by P01-PICKER-MEMORY, and acceptSuggestion discards the Bool at PhotoSuggestions.swift:80, so a repeated accept reports success without creating a second copy. Legacy photos with no assetID cannot be matched, which is correct.
assessments.regression_test: Existing: tests/native/main.swift:4253-4263 cover containsPhotoAsset, burst distinctness, restart and owner separation. Needed: a native test driving attachPhoto itself at capacity and for a repeated asset, because the existing checks exercise only the helper.

assessments.evidence: The Cancel button is disabled only by cancelling, not by busy (PhotoSuggestions.jsx:207). cancel() sets the run token while working (:106). The in-flight await completes and its outcome is recorded (:80-81), then remaining entries become 'cancelled' at :75-78 and the next import never starts. The status line reports the real counts through batchSummary. Cancelled photos lose their selection through selectionAfterBatch (photoSuggestions.js:255-262), but that does not break this defect's contract.
assessments.regression_test: Existing: PhotoSuggestions.test.jsx 'can cancel while the native import is busy and never starts the next photo' (deferred onImport, busy rerender). It could additionally assert the final '1 added · 1 cancelled' status.

assessments.evidence: Native computes nextOffset from the page window, not from surviving thumbnails (PhotoSuggestions.swift:37), and returns it at :63. Rows with no thumbnail are kept with null and localAvailable:false (:51-56). ActivityDetail prefers result.nextOffset (ActivityDetail.jsx:107,121-122) and steps over empty pages (:129). Load more and Cancel render outside the !items.length branch, so both stay reachable with zero visible rows (PhotoSuggestions.jsx:151,200-209). The empty copy no longer claims the library is exhausted when hasMore is true (:134-136).
assessments.regression_test: Existing: ActivityDetail.test.jsx 'asks for the next page with the cursor native returned...' and 'steps over an appended page that renders nothing...'; PhotoSuggestions.test.jsx 'does not call a fully imported first page the end of the library' and 'keeps an iCloud-only candidate visible...'. No native test covers the suggestPhotos row or cursor contract.

assessments.evidence: Native returns hasLocation from asset.location and locationSource 'photo' or 'timestamp' (PhotoSuggestions.swift:56). suggestionConfidence labels this 'Date match · photo GPS' or 'Date match only', and its detail says proximity to the route has not been verified (photoSuggestions.js:79-83). No route-match claim remains.
assessments.regression_test: Existing: src/lib/photoSuggestions.test.js suggestion label and confidence cases. Needed: a native assertion on the emitted hasLocation and locationSource fields.

assessments.evidence: Selection is scoped by owner and activity (ActivityDetail.jsx:28-34), passed to JourneyMap (:188) and stamped selected:true on the matching pin only (appleMaps.js:30). 'selected' is excluded from structureKey and snapshotKey (AppleMap.jsx:116-117), so it travels through update, not embed. Native apply replaces just that annotation because pinID excludes selected (AppleMaps.swift:654-658,876-880), with no selectAnnotation or camera call. The embedded renderer styles it pink (:2138-2142,2148) and the fullscreen renderer orange (:2050-2054,2061).
assessments.regression_test: Existing: JourneyMap.test.jsx:43 (selectedPhotoID) and AppleMap.test.jsx 'adds a photo through incremental update without re-embedding...'. Needed: an ActivityDetail test that selection clears on an owner or activity mismatch.

assessments.evidence: ActivityPhoto.thumbnailDataURL prefixes data:image/jpeg;base64, and returns nil for nil or empty input (RecorderCore.swift:2284-2287). The real bridge row uses it, with NSNull for unavailable values (PhotoSuggestions.swift:51-56). PrivateImage passes any non private-photo: src straight to (PrivateImage.jsx:6-7).
assessments.regression_test: Existing: tests/native/main.swift:4265-4267 cover the helper. The suggestPhotos call site itself is not tested.

assessments.evidence: setSuggestions appends every page through mergeSuggestionPages with no cap or eviction (ActivityDetail.jsx:119; photoSuggestions.js:63-71). Each row keeps its base64 thumbnail. PhotoSuggestions copies all rows (:36) and renders every tile with no window (:160-194). loading=lazy cannot help because the data URI bytes are already in JS memory. The largest component fixture is about one page.
assessments.regression_test: Needed: a PhotoSuggestions and ActivityDetail test with 1000+ candidates asserting bounded retained thumbnail bytes and DOM tiles, reachability of every candidate, thumbnail refetch on revisit, stable selection across eviction, and a selected import with partial failure from an evicted page.

assessments.evidence: The picker returns only selected, added, duplicates and failed:[String] (ActivityServices.swift:537,553). Failure strings carry no item identity, and results and providers are dropped when the callback ends. ActivityDetail joins the strings into a message with no retry action (ActivityDetail.jsx:172-177). The only progress shown is the static 'Adding photos…' (ActivityMoments.jsx:15). Failed images with no error message are silently omitted from failed (ActivityServices.swift:539-541).
assessments.regression_test: Needed: a native outcome-contract test (per-item identity, bounded retained providers, clearing on account change and cancel) and an ActivityDetail test for partial picker success then retry of failures only, with real progress. Existing 'reports a partially imported photo selection by name...' covers only the aggregate message.

assessments.evidence: All selected providers (up to 20) load with loadObject(ofClass:UIImage.self) at once (ActivityServices.swift:521-532). Decoded UIImages are held in images until the group finishes, and entries are not released after persistence (:519,538-550). attachPhoto then resizes and runs up to five JPEG passes on the main queue (:189-199). Peak memory therefore scales with full-resolution selection size and the main thread is blocked for the batch.
assessments.regression_test: Needed: a native test with a fake provider that asserts maximum concurrent loads, release before the next item, preserved selection order, capacity and duplicate outcomes, and owner change. Actual memory numbers remain a device measurement; the bound itself is software.

assessments.evidence: Only UIImage is loaded (ActivityServices.swift:524). asset is nil unless Photos is authorized or limited (:536,544). attachPhoto reads capture time and location only from asset (:206-208), so the picker-only path gets time nil and 'unlocated', and matchedPhotoPoint cannot infer a position (:209). No file or data representation or ImageIO metadata is read from the selected provider.
assessments.regression_test: Needed: a native metadata-extraction test using fixture images with EXIF time, offset and GPS and with stripped metadata, across denied, limited and full access, proving nothing is invented and no broad Photos request is made.

assessments.evidence: embeddedOnce is set only after the embed promise resolves (AppleMap.jsx:177). Unmount cleanup sends unembed only if embeddedOnce is true, otherwise only close (:43-47). Once appleMaps.embed has been sent, the late result is ignored at :176 with no teardown. Native close only dismisses a presented map (AppleMaps.swift:1886-1891), so the MKMapView stays in embeddedMaps and in webView.scrollView above the web content (:1759-1768). The test file has no unmount-before-resolve case; its only related unmount is the embedded case at line 135.
assessments.regression_test: Needed in AppleMap.test.jsx: defer mocks.embed, unmount, resolve, and assert unembed for that mapID. Add StrictMode replay, owner or navigation switch, and out-of-order callbacks, and assert cleanup is idempotent.

assessments.evidence: When hidden, JS clears embeddedOnce and calls unembed (AppleMap.jsx:145-148). Native destroys the map, coordinator and embeddedContent (AppleMaps.swift:1875-1882). On resume preserveViewport is false (AppleMap.jsx:166), and previousContent is nil so initialPositions is true and setVisibleMapRect refits (AppleMaps.swift:1825-1828). remember() from detach returns early when content.camera is nil (:1327-1328), so Activity Details maps get no camera memory. The test 'releases the native map on tab change...' covers people-map camera intents only.
assessments.regression_test: Needed: a bridge test that fires visibilitychange hidden then visible on a route map and asserts no unembed or a restored camera, plus a native CameraMemory-style test keyed by owner and content that clears on account change. Confirming no visible refit also needs a device pass.

assessments.evidence: The JS open path unembeds, which destroys the map (AppleMap.jsx:232-233), opens with no camera (:236-238), then resets embeddedOnce and re-embeds without preservation (:243-246). The native expand button does capture initialCamera (AppleMaps.swift:1790), but viewDidLoad applies it only for people or overview maps (:1954-1969). An Activity Details route map falls through to the fit at :1985, and embedded?.resumeFromMemory() is a no-op with no camera intent (:1321-1322). Either way a panned camera does not survive the round trip on this screen.
assessments.regression_test: Needed: a user-panned round-trip test for both the JS open path and the native expand path on a route map, asserting one visible map and no fit. Existing 'opens the same trimmed route in fullscreen...' checks content only.

assessments.evidence: Find journey photos sits near the top (ActivityMoments.jsx:24,36), but PhotoSuggestions renders at ActivityDetail.jsx:225, after diagnostics, metrics, facts, stops, story and photo management. No scrollIntoView, .focus(), detent change or dialog exists in ActivityDetail, ActivitySheet, ActivityMoments or PhotoSuggestions. .suggestion-actions is sticky only within its own section (styles.css:1173). Search and Add Photos feedback also appears only at line 215 once suggestions close. At line 225 the surface is effectively an appended section.
assessments.regression_test: Needed: a journey test from tapping Find journey photos to a visible, focused dedicated surface, with Back, Cancel and Add Selected reachable, keyboard focus returned on close, and selection stable.

assessments.evidence: surfaceGeometry derives height from navTop minus viewport-relative box.top (mapViewport.js:14-17), and geometryKey includes height (:33). With a map overlapping the bottom nav, a scroll with a constant document position changes the key and sends a resize (AppleMap.jsx:152-163). If it clips under MAP_MIN_EXTENT, visible goes false and the map is unembedded (:151), losing the camera. The test 'reports the same document position while the page scrolls' has no nav, so it does not cover this case. Activity Details on phones mostly avoids this; other map consumers still use the path.
assessments.regression_test: Needed in mapViewport.test.js: the same pageY at two scrollY values with navTop set must produce an identical geometry key. Needed in AppleMap.test.jsx: scroll across the nav sends no resize or unembed, and clipping is handled separately from geometry and content.

assessments.evidence: fullPreview and layers depend on the whole trip (ActivityDetail.jsx:61,69). perform() replaces trip after every import through recordedJourney, which also rebuilds segments (ActivityDetail.jsx:85-86; recorder.js:97), and trip.points comes from a fresh bridge result, so memoizing on the points reference alone would not be enough. JourneyMap rebuilds mapPayload on every render (JourneyMap.jsx:18). AppleMap stringifies and parses the whole payload every render (AppleMap.jsx:97-117), then sends the full route through update (:118-121). Pin-only selection rerenders ActivityDetail and takes this full path. A sheet drag does not, because detent state is local to ActivitySheet. No long-route count test exists.
assessments.regression_test: Needed: an instrumented long-track fixture through a multi-photo import and pin selection, asserting recordedRouteSegments and mapPayload counts and that update payloads omit unchanged route geometry, plus a privacy-revocation case for the people-pin update path.

assessments.evidence: The preview sets only role=dialog and aria-modal (PhotoSuggestions.jsx:210-221). A search of these components finds no .focus(), focus trap, inert or Escape handling. Focus stays on the obscured Preview button, and the background remains tabbable. On close, Done only clears state (:219), so focus is not restored. If the bottom nav is rendered on this screen it stays above the preview, since it has z-index 500 against page z-index 30 (styles.css:4,1162). The existing test checks only selection.
assessments.regression_test: Needed in PhotoSuggestions.test.jsx: a keyboard-only flow asserting focus enters the dialog, Tab stays inside, Escape closes, focus returns to the originating Preview button, the background is inert and selection is preserved. Existing 'previews a photo full screen...' covers selection only.

assessments.evidence: readers is a Set (mapDiagnostics.js:13), and every AppleMap registers the same function (AppleMap.jsx:63). Overlapping maps collapse to one entry. The first release deletes it, empties the Set and removes the window globals while another map is live (mapDiagnostics.js:27-32). Counts are also incomplete: the restore call appleMaps.hide({hidden:false}) has no recordMapEvent (AppleMap.jsx:144). The existing test covers a single consumer.
assessments.regression_test: Needed in mapDiagnostics.test.js: two registrations of the same reader, release one, the global remains and reads once; release the other, the global is removed. Needed in AppleMap.test.jsx: dialog restore counts a hide event.

assessments.evidence: New UI uses fixed tiny type: 9px at styles.css:1098; 10px at :1100,1103,1117; 11px at :1116,1118,1119,1151. styles.css has no -apple-system text style or text-size-adjust, so nothing follows iOS Dynamic Type in the WebView. Controls below 44pt remain: the 30px handle (:1141) and 24px tile checkboxes (:1124). Reduce Motion is handled (:1169). Info.plist allows landscape (lines 58-63), but sheetHeight leaves only about 250px at a 390px height, reduced further by the handle and 74px bottom padding (activitySheet.js:11-15; styles.css:1165), and there is no landscape layout. Missing scaling is software; only the physical VoiceOver and Dynamic Type pass is a device check.
assessments.regression_test: Needed: a check-activity-layout.mjs extension asserting a minimum and scalable font size, 44pt hit targets, and small-portrait and landscape sheet content height using the real stylesheet. Physical Dynamic Type and VoiceOver stay under DEVICE-NATIVE-UX.

assessments.evidence: activeCalories accepts only explicit kcal fields and activeEnergy with activeEnergyUnit==='kcal' (activitySummary.js:72-77). Unitless aliases are gone. Measured zero passes and missing is omitted (:78-83). The Apple Watch attribution needs source watch and energySource healthkit (:80). Elevation uses 4 m hysteresis, ignores invalid or zero altitude, skips low-accuracy fixes, breaks on segment and on gaps over 300 s (:19-61), and is labelled 'Estimated from recorded altitude' when derived (:104). The comment 'Every plausible key is checked' at :64 is stale but does not change behavior. Watch collection stays phase 2.
assessments.regression_test: Existing in activitySummary.test.js: 'rejects untyped energy aliases and distinguishes measured zero from missing energy', 'does not turn altitude jitter, invalid fixes or pauses into climb', 'only attributes calories to Apple Watch when the recording source says watch'.

assessments.evidence: The .swipe-back-page wrapper no longer has permanent will-change (styles.css:32). SwipeBack transforms the fixed page (.detail-sheet-page) and sets will-change only during a gesture, clearing it on reset (SwipeBack.jsx:6-7,18). The fixed-page rule also applies to coarse-pointer landscape (styles.css:1161-1165), and the handle has touch-action:none for direct drag (:1141). check-activity-layout.mjs checks both orientations in Chromium and reproduces the old offset in portrait. That evidence is a synthetic CSS fixture, not native performance. SwipeBack.test.jsx renders no .detail-sheet-page, so targeting the fixed page has no unit assertion, and whether the native map tracks the page during a swipe is unproven here.
assessments.regression_test: Existing: scripts/check-activity-layout.mjs (npm run test:activity-layout); ActivitySheet.test.jsx pointer test. Needed: a SwipeBack.test.jsx case asserting the transform lands on .detail-sheet-page and will-change clears on reset.

assessments.evidence: release-gates.md, review-findings.md and testing.md are current and correctly say BLOCKED, with software separate from hardware. Stale reports about those files should not be repeated. The current contradictions are all in progress.md, which still claims completion or defers software. Line 71 ticks R8-01 [x] 'Done for phase 1', with camera preserved and cleanup on unmount/background, against LATE-EMBED and CAMERA-RESUME. Line 38 says R3-03 Done against release-gates.md:12. Line 37 says capture time is preserved, against the picker-only path. Line 33 says a selected photo cannot highlight its pin, against release-gates.md:16 and AppleMaps.swift:2050,2138. Line 45 sends memory and DOM bounds to a gate R-G5 and line 34 sends Dynamic Type to R-G6, though release-gates.md no longer defines R-G IDs, and line 45 calls thumbnails bounded per page while pages accumulate without limit. Line 43 quotes 'Add N photos' while the UI says 'Add Selected (N)'. Line 9 quotes 995 and 1752 against the frozen 996 and 1755. Severity is P2 because lines 91 and 103 of the same file state these ticks are developer claims and the outcome is BLOCKED, so no reader of the authoritative sections is told the phase passed. The ledger rows should still be corrected.
assessments.regression_test: Needed: a docs check failing when a ledger row is ticked or Done while its ID is listed as open, or when it references an undefined gate or finding ID. Otherwise reconcile manually on the next docs pass.

assessments.evidence: testing.md:46 and release-gates.md:26-30 state no actual November ride, iPhone or Watch acceptance, native frame traces, VoiceOver session, or battery, thermal or HealthKit validation has occurred. None of these can be established from source. This gate does not cover the software defects above, including A11Y-TYPE, GALLERY-MEMORY and PICKER-MEMORY.
assessments.regression_test: Manual device acceptance: an actual ride with Photos import, native frame traces during sheet drag and scroll, a VoiceOver and Dynamic Type pass, and Watch battery and HealthKit checks. No automated test replaces this.
